gates.title: Install the Slack app on the Enterprise Grid org
gates.detail: Create a Slack app from slack/manifest.json and install it on the Enterprise Grid org, not on a single workspace. Grant it to workspaces created later, and approve it if an admin must. Skip this when that org install already exists.

gates.title: Store the Slack tokens
gates.detail: Put the bot token in a Salesforce named credential for https://slack.com/api. Keep the org-admin user token, the one with admin.teams:write, in the coding agent's secret store. The agent uses it to create a workspace. Keep both tokens out of git. Skip this when both are already stored.

gates.title: Connect the Salesforce org to seed
gates.detail: Sign the coding agent into the Salesforce org that should receive the records and the publisher flow. A demo org is the usual choice. The agent uses whichever org that login opens.

gates.title: Deploy the Salesforce flow that posts to Slack
gates.detail: The flow is an after-save flow on Case. It posts salesforce/slack-post.json into the new workspace when a tagged case is created or its status changes. Deploy it with the Salesforce CLI or Metadata API. Skip this when that flow is already active.

gates.title: Create new objects, fields, or Apex yourself
gates.detail: This brief asks for metadata beyond the publisher flow. Add it in Salesforce Setup, or take it out of the flow. The agent creates records on objects the org already has.
